source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the ironic request and emphatic repetition.
key_decisions.before: I wish you would bear with me in a little foolishness. Indeed, do bear with me.
key_decisions.after: I wish you would put up with a little foolishness from me. Indeed, do put up with me!
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I wish you would bear with me in a little foolishness. Indeed, do bear with me.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps betrothal metaphor, gender, and divine jealousy.
key_decisions.before: For I feel a divine jealousy for you, since I betrothed you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
key_decisions.after: For I am jealous for you with God's jealousy, because I promised you to one husband, to present you to Christ as a pure virgin.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For I feel a divine jealousy for you, since I betrothed you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Eve, deception, mental corruption, and variant-marked purity.
key_decisions.before: Yet I am afraid that just as the serpent deceived Eve by his cunning, your thoughts may be led astray from sincere and pure devotion to Christ.
key_decisions.after: But I fear that, just as the serpent deceived Eve by his cunning, your minds may be corrupted from sincere and pure devotion to Christ.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But I am afraid that just as the serpent deceived Eve by his cunning, your thoughts may be led astray from sincere and pure devotion to Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the threefold alternative and biting irony.
key_decisions.before: For if someone comes and proclaims another Jesus than the one we proclaimed, or you receive a different spirit than the one you received, or a different good news than the one you accepted—you put up with it readily enough.
key_decisions.after: For if someone comes proclaiming another Jesus whom we did not proclaim, or you receive a different spirit you did not receive, or a different gospel you did not accept, you put up with it well enough!
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For if someone comes and proclaims another Jesus than the one we proclaimed, or you receive a different spirit than the one you received, or a different good news than the one you accepted—you put up with it readily enough.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the ironic designation and comparison.
key_decisions.before: For I consider that I am not in the least inferior to these “super-apostles.”
key_decisions.after: For I consider myself in no way inferior to those “super-apostles.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For I consider that I am not in the least inferior to these “super-apostles.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves ironic question, reversal, and free proclamation.
key_decisions.before: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself so that you might be exalted, because I proclaimed the good news of God to you free of charge?
key_decisions.after: Or did I commit a sin by humbling myself so that you might be exalted, because I proclaimed God's gospel to you without charge?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself so that you might be exalted, because I proclaimed the good news of God to you free of charge?

key_decisions.rationale: Retains Paul's deliberately harsh robbery metaphor.
key_decisions.before: I robbed other churches, taking wages from them in order to serve you.
key_decisions.after: I robbed other churches by accepting support in order to serve you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I robbed other churches, taking wages from them in order to serve you.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps material need, source of aid, and resolve.
key_decisions.before: And when I was with you and was in need, I did not burden anyone; for the brothers and sisters who came from Macedonia supplied my need. So I kept myself from being a burden to you in any way, and will continue to do so.
key_decisions.after: And when I was with you and in need, I did not burden anyone, for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied what I lacked. In everything I kept myself from being a burden to you, and I will continue to do so.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And when I was with you and was in need, I did not burden anyone; for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied my need. So I kept myself from being a burden to you in any way, and will continue to do so.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves repeated opportunity and polemical aim.
key_decisions.before: And what I am doing I will continue to do, so that I may cut off the opportunity from people who desire an opportunity to be regarded just as we are in what they boast about.
key_decisions.after: But what I do, I will continue to do, in order to cut off the opportunity from those who want an opportunity to be regarded as our equals in what they boast about.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And what I am doing I will continue to do, so that I may cut off the opportunity from those who desire an opportunity to be regarded just as we are in what they boast about.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the direct accusations and disguise.
key_decisions.before: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, disguising themselves as apostles of Christ.
key_decisions.after: For such people are false apostles, deceitful workers, disguising themselves as apostles of Christ.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, disguising themselves as apostles of Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains Satan and deceptive transformation.
key_decisions.before: And no wonder, for even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light.
key_decisions.after: And no wonder, for Satan himself disguises himself as an angel of light.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And no wonder, for even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps agent relation, disguise, and final outcome.
key_decisions.before: So it is no great thing if his servants also disguise themselves as servants of righteousness. Their end will correspond to their deeds.
key_decisions.after: So it is no great surprise if his servants also disguise themselves as servants of righteousness. Their end will correspond to their works.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So it is no great thing if his servants also disguise themselves as servants of righteousness. Their end will correspond to their deeds.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Paul's explicit qualification of his speech.
key_decisions.before: What I am saying in this boastful confidence, I say not according to the Lord, but as in foolishness.
key_decisions.after: What I am saying, I am not saying according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, with this confidence in boasting.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: What I am saying in this boastful confidence, I say not according to the Lord, but as in foolishness.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps sharp irony and direct address.
key_decisions.before: For you gladly bear with fools, being wise yourselves.
key_decisions.after: For you gladly put up with fools, since you yourselves are so wise!
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For you gladly bear with fools, being wise yourselves.

key_decisions.rationale: Names domination, exploitation, arrogance, and physical violence.
key_decisions.before: For you bear it if someone enslaves you, devours you, takes advantage of you, exalts himself, or strikes you in the face.
key_decisions.after: Indeed, you put up with it if someone enslaves you, devours you, takes from you, exalts himself, or strikes you in the face.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For you bear it if someone enslaves you, devours you, takes advantage of you, exalts himself, or strikes you in the face.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps sarcasm, weakness, and qualified rivalry.
key_decisions.before: To my shame, I must say, we were too weak for that! But whatever anyone else dares to boast of—I am speaking in foolishness—I also dare.
key_decisions.after: To our shame, I admit that we were too weak for that! But whatever anyone dares to boast about—I speak in foolishness—I also dare. But whatever anyone else dares to boast of—I am speaking in foolishness—I also dare.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: To my shame, I must say, we were too weak for that! But whatever anyone else dares to boast of—I am speaking in foolishness—I also dare.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Paul's disclaimer and actual harms.
key_decisions.before: Are they servants of Christ? I am speaking as one beside himself—I more so: in labors more abundant, in imprisonments more frequent, in beatings beyond measure, in deaths often.
key_decisions.after: Are they servants of Christ? I am speaking like a madman: I am far more—in far more labors, far more imprisonments, countless beatings, and often near death.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Are they servants of Christ? I am speaking as one beside himself—I more so: in labors more abundant, in imprisonments more frequent, in beatings beyond measure, in deaths often.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves exact number, agents, and punishment.
key_decisions.before: Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.
key_decisions.after: Five times I received from the Jews forty lashes minus one.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps all counts and bodily dangers.
key_decisions.before: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I was shipwrecked; a night and a day I was adrift at sea;
key_decisions.after: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked; I spent a night and a day in the open sea.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I was shipwrecked; a night and a day I was adrift at sea;

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves repeated danger and all locations/groups.
key_decisions.before: in journeys often, in dangers from rivers, dangers from robbers, dangers from my own people, dangers from Gentiles, dangers in the city, dangers in the wilderness, dangers at sea, dangers among false brothers and sisters;
key_decisions.after: I have often been on journeys, in danger from rivers, danger from robbers, danger from my own people, danger from Gentiles, danger in the city, danger in the wilderness, danger at sea, danger among false brothers,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: in journeys often, in dangers from rivers, dangers from robbers, dangers from my own people, dangers from Gentiles, dangers in the city, dangers in the wilderness, dangers at sea, dangers among false brothers;

key_decisions.rationale: Names deprivation without spiritualizing it.
key_decisions.before: in toil and hardship, in sleepless nights often, in hunger and thirst, often without food, in cold and exposure.
key_decisions.after: in toil and hardship, through many sleepless nights, in hunger and thirst, often without food, in cold and without enough clothing.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: in toil and hardship, in sleepless nights often, in hunger and thirst, often without food, in cold and exposure.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the internal pressure and daily scope.
key_decisions.before: And apart from other things, there is the daily pressure on me of my concern for all the churches.
key_decisions.after: Besides everything else, there is the daily pressure on me: my concern for all the churches.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And apart from other things, there is the daily pressure on me of my concern for all the churches.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves solidarity and fiery emotional image.
key_decisions.before: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I am not inflamed?
key_decisions.after: Who is weak without my sharing their weakness? Who is made to stumble without my burning with distress?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I am not inflamed?

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps offices, ruler, place, and intended capture.
key_decisions.before: In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas was guarding the city of the Damascenes in order to seize me,
key_decisions.after: In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas guarded the city of the Damascenes in order to seize me,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas was guarding the city of the Damascenes in order to seize me,

key_decisions.after: but I was lowered in a basket through a window in the wall and escaped his hands.
